questions.prompt: The model sends {"path":"a.ts","limit":"ten"} to read_file, whose schema says limit is an integer. What happens?
options: The tool runs and ignores limit
The tool runs and crashes when it uses limit
The tool does not run; the model gets an error result saying limit should be integer, got string
questions.explanation: checkArgs compares each field's type with the schema before execute is called and returns one clear sentence as the error result.

questions.prompt: Why does the not-valid-JSON error quote the start of the raw arguments?
options: So the model can see what it actually sent and correct it
Because the error must be at least 200 characters
So the program can retry parsing later
questions.explanation: Showing the broken text lets the model spot its own mistake, such as a cut-off string, on the next step.

questions.prompt: Which check must stay inside the edit tool instead of the schema validator?
options: That no unknown fields were sent
That old_string is not empty and differs from new_string
questions.explanation: The schema only states fields and types. Rules that compare values, such as old_string differing from new_string, are checked by the tool itself.
